suggestions.before:
match any
  subject contains "invoice"
  subject contains "payment"
suggestions.after:
match all
  any
    subject contains "invoice"
    subject contains "payment"
  not from.address has domain "bank.example"
suggestions.why: The judge said no to all 4 messages from this sending domain in the last 30 days, and yes to none. Leaving it out before the judge is asked saves about 4 judge calls a month.
Every one of the 2 messages you kept scored 0.86 or more, and the 2 you dismissed scored 0.73 at most. A bar of 0.79, between them, keeps the first and leaves out the second.

suggestions.before: Is this asking me to pay or send something?
suggestions.after: Is the sender asking me to pay them, or to send them an invoice?
suggestions.why: It names who asks for what.
This rule has no history on this Mac yet, so there is nothing to count: the suggestions come from its text alone.
